{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Camellya |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = My mind has grown numb with monotony for the past decade or so. I handle exciting jobs sometimes, but the fun soon dries up, like tidal marks on the shoal. But you... you're the only one who keeps me on my toes. So of course I'd be paying attention to you. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = My stance? Ha! I didn't join {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}} to save the world. Just needed a way to pass the time on this island. Justice, truth… Saints spout them, sinners exploit them, all for their own gains. Me? I need nothing and want nothing. Pretty words hold no power over me. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Why did you... come here? Told you not to... Cough cough! Not to visit... while I'm here in the pod... Hehe, a cute girl like me needs her privacy, you know? ...I hate myself like this... don't look. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = You know what? I dreamed of you while I was in the medical pod. In that dream… I couldn't get to know you. Your name echoed in my head endlessly as we roamed the same places, but I never saw your face, not even once... How odd... |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Saving the world? Couldn't care less. This cage of a world only consumes and binds you with responsibility. But if you believe it's the right thing to do… Go for it! You're staying true to yourself, and I like that. It's beautiful, we both find joy in our own paths! But if you ever get tired of this whole savior business, do let me know… What will I do? Hehe... Secret! |vo_02_01_title = Camellya's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Napping in the sun on a warm afternoon is so cozy, I just need to find a quiet place. Sleeping in the warmth, nestled among branches and leaves... |vo_02_02_title = Camellya's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Working for {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}} has been a snooze fest. I tried to spice it up by picking the toughest jobs, didn't help. There's no one worth my time on {{Extra Effect|Solaris|Solaris|SOL-3, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.}} now. I'm dying of boredom! |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Fruit juice. Fresh, raw, and tangy. That gentle sweetness lingers... You want some? |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Pick the best seeds, protect them till they're ripe. Then comes the fun—I'll have worthy opponents to fight! I don't care about the rest. We'll all die one day, might as well dance and live it up while we can. Responsibility? Ideals? Those are just lies we tell ourselves to feel better, nothing but a false high. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = This bracelet was a gift from you. I remember it's meant to monitor my frequency. Then in case I'm in trouble, you can find me. Convenient, right? It's been broken for years now, though... |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = I'm a regular at the medical pod. The docs must be surprised I'm still alive after all these years. Binders are my saving grace—can't handle the pain without them. That's how I made it through alive every time. Don't look at me like that. I see nothing bad about it. Being on death's doorstep taught me to stay true to myself. Betraying life is worse than any lie. You have to embrace yourself to find real joy. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Encore]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Encore.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together. |vo_04_01_mention = Encore |vo_04_02_title = About [[Shorekeeper]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Shorekeeper.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = She's always so serious, following every rule despite being our de facto leader now. Well, she's taken care of me before on many occasions, so I gotta show some respect... Wait, I've been a Bloom Bearer for years? How time flies… |vo_04_02_mention = Shorekeeper |vo_04_03_title = About [[Aalto]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Aalto.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Aalto's a master at mind games. It's hard to get under his skin! He's not strong enough to pique my interest though. That guy relies on trickery too much for my liking. |vo_04_03_mention = Aalto |vo_04_04_title = About [[Jinhsi]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Jinhsi.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = The Loong Maiden of {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}} reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice! I don't understand, why must they burden themselves so much? |vo_04_04_mention = Jinhsi, Shorekeeper |vo_04_05_title = About [[Jianxin]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Jianxin.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then. |vo_04_05_mention = Jianxin |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Your birthday is the most wonderful day. Without you, my life would be so empty and dull! Being with you again brings me peace. I am content now. Hey, put your Terminal away, great savior of {{Extra Effect|Solaris}}! I blocked all signals here so we can be undisturbed. Today, you're mine, and no one else's. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Hehe... How do you like this flower? |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = *Effort Sound* |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = *Effort Sound* |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}}. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Hehe... I'm looking forward to our game. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Pleasure me with more power! |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Where are you, my lovely seeds? |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Don't bore me, okay? |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Ahh... I love it... The power surging through my veins...! |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Oops, watch out for my thorns. Don't get your fingers pierced. Hmm... on second thought, not much can harm you anyway. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Hey, care to join me for another round? I'll show you a whole bunch of new tricks and powers, promise! |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = ...Ugh! Hah... I-I'm fine, I just... need some time, to ride out the pain... Swallow it whole, make the chaotic frequencies my strength... |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = With this power, I am whole again... Now we can truly play as equals. After all, it's not just what you play... but who you play with.
